context: Daichi takes Mei out for an anniversary dinner; tender quiet.
purpose: Married couple sharing significant anniversary moment.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Warm, grounded opening. Kansai inflection on the final word—elongated, tender. Slow pace. The voice of someone who has said this before and means it differently each time.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Quiet wonder underneath. Soft intake of breath before speaking. Warm but slightly disbelieving—like the time surprised her. Trailing off on the final syllable, eyes uncertain but glad.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: We've made it this far together.
lines.style: Kansai warmth, soft and foundational. Not a question—a quiet statement of fact, with gratitude underneath. Steady pace. The tone of someone marveling at something solid he helped build.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: これからも、ずっと一緒。
lines.style: Gentle certainty. Soft opening, slight weight on 「いつまでも」. Not a promise being made—one being reaffirmed. Warm, present. No rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Contented exhale. Kansai gentleness—unhurried, full. Soft consonants. The voice of someone taking inventory of something he didn't expect to have this much of.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Thank you. I love you so much.
lines.style: Tender and direct. No performance—just the accumulated ease of saying this to someone who knows what it means. Warm, steady. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai roughness softened by sincerity. Short, unhurried. Weight on 「ほんま」—Kansai for 'truly,' delivered with quiet certainty. The honesty of someone who doesn't say more than he means.
